Administration in children. In the UK, tramadol hydrochlo- ride is licensed for the management of moderate to severe pain in children 12 years of age and older; usual adult doses may be giv- en (see above). However, in some other European countries it is licensed in younger children although the age range permitted can vary: for example, in France, a usual dose in those aged 3 years and over is 1 to 2 mg/kg orally, which may be repeated 3 or 4 times
